technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with volume spike present, but severe downtrend structure (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, below cloud) and lack of momentum confirmation make this a high-risk bounce play rather than a reliable swing entry.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 13 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/stale with no clear conviction signal, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (394.56), flat yield curve with recession signals, FOMC just passed (-2 days), and earnings in 13 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for STZ.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) + stochastic bullish cross + 15x volume spike create textbook bounce setup with price near support (209.01), offering asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian traders in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe downtrend structure (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, below Ichimoku cloud), no momentum confirmation despite oversold conditions, imminent earnings volatility (13 days), crisis VIX regime, and FOMC headwinds make this a high-probability false bounce trap rather than reliable swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and stochastic cross with 15x volume spike present textbook bounce mechanics; however, severe downtrend structure (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, below cloud) and lack of momentum confirmation eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 13 days combined with crisis VIX regime (394.56) and FOMC headwinds create high probability of false bounce trap; macro environment is acutely unfavourable for swing entries.
